facts.text: I asked whether camels have a unique gait that minimizes heat loss while carrying heavy loads.
I asked whether camels can run like horses.
I asked whether camels are really grumpy and bad-tempered as people say.
I said I wouldn't want to mess with a grumpy camel.
I asked whether I have ever ridden a camel.
I said riding a camel would be quite an adventure.
